sprints.name: Foundation
sprints.goal: Basic Cloudflare Worker that receives HTTP requests, routes them, and responds with JSON
sprints.demo: curl POST /catch/test returns {status:accepted}, GET /health returns status

tasks.name: Project Scaffolding
tasks.description: Initialize Wrangler project with TypeScript, configure wrangler.toml and tsconfig.json with strict mode
tasks.validation: wrangler dev starts without errors

tasks.name: Health Endpoint
tasks.description: Create src/index.ts with basic request handler, implement GET /health returning {status:healthy,version:0.1.0}
tasks.validation: Unit test verifies response shape and status code 200

tasks.name: Router Implementation
tasks.description: Create src/router.ts with path matching logic, support /catch/:source pattern with param extraction, handle 404
tasks.validation: Unit tests for path matching, param extraction, 404 handling

tasks.name: Catch Endpoint Stub
tasks.description: Create POST /catch/:source endpoint, extract source param, return accepted response, reject non-POST with 405
tasks.validation: Unit tests for POST acceptance, method rejection, param extraction

tasks.name: Request Body Parsing
tasks.description: Parse JSON body from requests, handle malformed JSON with 400, handle empty body gracefully
tasks.validation: Unit tests for valid JSON, invalid JSON, empty body

tasks.name: Error Handling Middleware
tasks.description: Create centralized error handler, return consistent {status:error,error:message} format, log to console
tasks.validation: Unit tests verify error responses for thrown exceptions

tasks.name: Local Development Setup
tasks.description: Add npm run dev/test scripts, create .dev.vars.example template
tasks.validation: npm run dev and npm run test both work

sprints.name: GitHub Webhook Support
sprints.goal: Receive GitHub webhooks, validate HMAC-SHA256 signatures, parse events
sprints.demo: Mock GitHub webhook with valid signature accepted, invalid signature rejected

tasks.name: Types Definition
tasks.description: Create src/types.ts with NormalizedEvent interface, WebhookSource enum, WebhookHandler interface
tasks.validation: TypeScript compiles without errors

tasks.name: HMAC-SHA256 Utility
tasks.description: Create src/crypto/hmac.ts with verifyHmacSha256(secret, payload, signature) using Web Crypto API
tasks.validation: Unit tests with known HMAC vectors, invalid signatures, empty inputs

tasks.name: GitHub Signature Parser
tasks.description: Create src/handlers/github/signature.ts, parse X-Hub-Signature-256 header (sha256=hex format)
tasks.validation: Unit tests for valid header, missing header, malformed format

tasks.name: GitHub Signature Verification
tasks.description: Create src/handlers/github/verify.ts combining HMAC utility with signature parser
tasks.validation: Unit tests with real GitHub webhook examples, invalid signatures

tasks.name: GitHub Event Type Extractor
tasks.description: Create src/handlers/github/events.ts, parse X-GitHub-Event and X-GitHub-Delivery headers, map to normalized names
tasks.validation: Unit tests for header extraction, event mapping

tasks.name: GitHub Payload Normalizer
tasks.description: Create src/handlers/github/normalize.ts, transform payload to NormalizedEvent, extract repo/action/sender
tasks.validation: Unit tests with sample payloads for push, star, PR, issues

tasks.name: GitHub Handler Integration
tasks.description: Create src/handlers/github/index.ts implementing WebhookHandler interface, wire into router
tasks.validation: Integration test: mock request → handler → normalized response

tasks.name: Environment Variable Access
tasks.description: Create src/config/env.ts with typed Env interface, add GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET to wrangler.toml
tasks.validation: TypeScript provides autocomplete for env vars

sprints.name: Multi-Source Support
sprints.goal: Add Stripe, Vercel, and generic webhook handlers with their signature schemes
sprints.demo: All four sources accept webhooks with valid signatures, reject invalid ones

tasks.name: Stripe Signature Parser
tasks.description: Create src/handlers/stripe/signature.ts, parse Stripe-Signature header (t=timestamp,v1=signature)
tasks.validation: Unit tests for header parsing, missing components

tasks.name: Stripe Signature Verification
tasks.description: Implement Stripe scheme: HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp.payload), verify timestamp tolerance (5 min)
tasks.validation: Unit tests with Stripe test vectors, expired timestamps

tasks.name: Stripe Event Normalizer
tasks.description: Create src/handlers/stripe/normalize.ts, map event types, extract amount/customer fields
tasks.validation: Unit tests with sample Stripe payloads

tasks.name: Stripe Handler Integration
tasks.description: Create src/handlers/stripe/index.ts, implement WebhookHandler, wire to /catch/stripe
tasks.validation: Integration test with mock Stripe webhook

tasks.name: Vercel Signature Verification
tasks.description: Create src/handlers/vercel/verify.ts with HMAC-SHA1 verification, parse X-Vercel-Signature
tasks.validation: Unit tests with mock Vercel signatures

tasks.name: Vercel Event Normalizer
tasks.description: Create src/handlers/vercel/normalize.ts, map deployment events (created, succeeded, failed)
tasks.validation: Unit tests with sample Vercel payloads

tasks.name: Vercel Handler Integration
tasks.description: Create src/handlers/vercel/index.ts, implement WebhookHandler, wire to /catch/vercel
tasks.validation: Integration test with mock Vercel webhook

tasks.name: Generic/Custom Handler
tasks.description: Create src/handlers/custom/index.ts with HMAC-SHA256 via X-Webhook-Signature, pass-through normalization
tasks.validation: Unit tests for signature verification, pass-through behavior

tasks.name: Handler Registry
tasks.description: Create src/handlers/registry.ts mapping source names to handlers, getHandler(source) function
tasks.validation: Unit tests for handler lookup, unknown source handling

tasks.name: Router Handler Integration
tasks.description: Update router to use handler registry, return 400 for unknown sources
tasks.validation: Integration tests for all four sources through router

sprints.name: Clawdbot Integration
sprints.goal: Forward normalized events to Clawdbot hooks endpoint with authentication
sprints.demo: Webhook received → normalized → forwarded to Clawdbot → TARS receives message

tasks.name: HTTP Client Utility
tasks.description: Create src/http/client.ts with postJson(url, body, headers), handle 10s timeout
tasks.validation: Unit tests with mocked fetch

tasks.name: Clawdbot Client
tasks.description: Create src/clawdbot/client.ts with forwardEvent(event), add Authorization and X-Webhook-Source headers
tasks.validation: Unit tests verify correct headers, body format

tasks.name: Clawdbot Response Handling
tasks.description: Handle 2xx success, 4xx/5xx errors, parse error responses for logging
tasks.validation: Unit tests for success, client error, server error responses

tasks.name: Forward Integration
tasks.description: Update handlers to call Clawdbot after normalization, add CLAWDBOT_HOOKS_URL/SECRET env vars
tasks.validation: Integration test: webhook → normalize → forward → response

tasks.name: Async Forwarding
tasks.description: Use ctx.waitUntil() for non-blocking forward, return accepted immediately
tasks.validation: Verify immediate response, background execution

tasks.name: Event ID Generation
tasks.description: Create src/utils/uuid.ts with crypto.randomUUID(), prefix with evt_
tasks.validation: Unit tests for format, uniqueness

tasks.name: Timestamp Handling
tasks.description: Create src/utils/time.ts with nowISO() returning UTC ISO 8601 timestamps
tasks.validation: Unit tests for format correctness

sprints.name: Reliability & Logging
sprints.goal: Add retry logic, KV logging, and failure handling
sprints.demo: Simulate Clawdbot down → retries → logs to KV → retrieve failed events

tasks.name: KV Namespace Setup
tasks.description: Add WEBHOOK_RELAY_LOGS KV namespace to wrangler.toml, create binding types
tasks.validation: wrangler kv:namespace list shows namespace

tasks.name: Event Logger
tasks.description: Create src/logging/event-logger.ts with logEvent(event, status, error?), store with 7-day TTL
tasks.validation: Unit tests with mocked KV, verify key format and TTL

tasks.name: Retrieve Logs Endpoint
tasks.description: Create GET /logs endpoint (auth required), support ?limit=N query param
tasks.validation: Integration test with seeded KV data

tasks.name: Retry Logic
tasks.description: Create src/http/retry.ts with withRetry(fn, attempts, delays), exponential backoff (1s, 5s, 30s)
tasks.validation: Unit tests for retry behavior, backoff timing

tasks.name: Clawdbot Client with Retry
tasks.description: Wrap forwardEvent with retry logic, log each attempt, return final status
tasks.validation: Integration test simulating failures then success

tasks.name: Dead Letter Logging
tasks.description: Log events failing all retries to KV with dead: prefix, include error and attempt history
tasks.validation: Unit tests verify dead letter format

tasks.name: Dead Letter Retrieval
tasks.description: Create GET /dead-letters endpoint (auth required), support marking as resolved
tasks.validation: Integration test for retrieval and resolution

tasks.name: Structured Logging
tasks.description: Create src/logging/logger.ts with log levels, include request ID/source/event context, JSON output
tasks.validation: Unit tests verify log format

tasks.name: Request ID Tracking
tasks.description: Generate unique request ID per webhook, include in logs and X-Request-ID response header
tasks.validation: Verify request ID propagation through handler chain

sprints.name: Configuration & Filtering
sprints.goal: KV-based configuration for enabling/disabling sources and filtering events
sprints.demo: Update KV config → source disabled → webhooks rejected; enable specific events only

tasks.name: Config KV Namespace
tasks.description: Add WEBHOOK_RELAY_CONFIG KV namespace, define config schema TypeScript types
tasks.validation: Namespace created and bound

tasks.name: Config Loader
tasks.description: Create src/config/loader.ts, load from KV with caching, fallback to defaults
tasks.validation: Unit tests for loading, caching, defaults

tasks.name: Source Enable/Disable
tasks.description: Check sources.<source>.enabled before processing, return 503 for disabled
tasks.validation: Integration test: disable source → webhook rejected

tasks.name: Event Filtering
tasks.description: Check sources.<source>.events array, support wildcards, skip forwarding for filtered events
tasks.validation: Unit tests for exact match, wildcard, no match

tasks.name: Config Update Endpoint
tasks.description: Create PUT /config endpoint (auth required), validate schema before storing
tasks.validation: Integration test for config update flow

tasks.name: Config Validation
tasks.description: Create src/config/validator.ts with JSON schema validation, reject invalid with detailed errors
tasks.validation: Unit tests for valid config, various invalid configs

tasks.name: Admin Authentication
tasks.description: Create src/auth/admin.ts checking Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_SECRET> header
tasks.validation: Unit tests for valid token, invalid token, missing token

sprints.name: Rate Limiting & Security
sprints.goal: Protect against abuse with rate limiting and enhanced security
sprints.demo: Exceed rate limit → 429 response; invalid signatures tracked and alerted

tasks.name: Rate Limiter Design
tasks.description: Create src/security/rate-limiter.ts using CF rate limiting or KV counter, track by IP
tasks.validation: Unit tests for counter increment, limit check

tasks.name: Rate Limit Middleware
tasks.description: Add rate limit check before processing, return 429 with Retry-After header
tasks.validation: Integration test simulating rate limit breach

tasks.name: Signature Failure Tracking
tasks.description: Count signature failures per source IP, log excessive failures
tasks.validation: Unit tests for failure counting

tasks.name: IP Blocking
tasks.description: Block IPs with excessive failures, store blocklist in KV with TTL
tasks.validation: Integration test for block trigger and enforcement

tasks.name: Sensitive Data Scrubbing
tasks.description: Create src/security/scrubber.ts removing tokens/secrets/passwords before logging
tasks.validation: Unit tests verify sensitive fields removed

tasks.name: CORS Headers
tasks.description: Add CORS headers for browser testing, restrict origins in production
tasks.validation: Verify CORS headers in responses

sprints.name: Deployment & Production
sprints.goal: Deploy to production with proper secrets management and monitoring
sprints.demo: Live webhook from GitHub → processed → TARS reacts in real-time

tasks.name: Wrangler Secrets Setup
tasks.description: Document all required secrets, create scripts/setup-secrets.sh
tasks.validation: All secrets configured in CF dashboard

tasks.name: Production Wrangler Config
tasks.description: Add production environment to wrangler.toml, configure custom domain and KV namespaces
tasks.validation: wrangler deploy --env production succeeds

tasks.name: CI/CD Pipeline
tasks.description: Create .github/workflows/deploy.yml, run tests on PR, deploy on main merge
tasks.validation: GitHub Actions workflow passes

tasks.name: Health Check Monitoring
tasks.description: Add external health check (UptimeRobot/Checkly), alert on failure
tasks.validation: Monitoring configured and alerting works

tasks.name: Error Alerting
tasks.description: Configure CF Worker analytics, set up alerts for error rate spikes
tasks.validation: Test alert triggers correctly

tasks.name: README Documentation
tasks.description: Write comprehensive README with setup, env vars, and testing examples
tasks.validation: Someone else can set up from README alone

tasks.name: GitHub Webhook Configuration
tasks.description: Document GitHub webhook setup pointing to relay, required events, test instructions
tasks.validation: Real GitHub webhook received and processed

tasks.name: End-to-End Verification
tasks.description: Trigger real webhook from each source, verify TARS receives and responds
tasks.validation: All sources working in production
